title: Runnables Module
summary: The runnables module provides a foundational interface for creating composable units of work, enabling declarative chain construction, and managing execution flow with features like batching, streaming, and configuration.

nodes.label: Runnable
nodes.title: Base Runnable Interface
nodes.description: Defines the core interface for composable units of work, supporting invocation, batching, streaming, and transformation. It provides methods for composition, configuration, and lifecycle management.

nodes.label: RunnableSerializable
nodes.title: Serializable Runnable
nodes.description: Extends the base Runnable to support serialization to JSON, enabling persistence and transferability of runnable definitions. It also introduces configurable fields and alternatives.

nodes.label: RunnableEachBase
nodes.title: Runnable for Sequence Processing
nodes.description: A runnable that applies another runnable to each element of an input sequence, effectively mapping a list of inputs to a list of outputs.

nodes.label: RunnableBindingBase
nodes.title: Runnable with Bound Arguments/Config
nodes.description: A runnable that delegates calls to an underlying runnable, allowing for binding of arguments, configuration, and custom input/output types.

nodes.label: DynamicRunnable
nodes.title: Dynamically Configurable Runnable
nodes.description: A serializable runnable that can be dynamically configured at runtime, typically created using configurable_fields or configurable_alternatives methods.

nodes.label: RunnableWithMessageHistory
nodes.title: Runnable with Message History
nodes.description: Manages chat message history for another runnable, handling the loading and updating of conversation history based on session configuration.

nodes.label: RunnablePassthrough
nodes.title: Input Passthrough Runnable
nodes.description: A runnable that passes inputs through unchanged, optionally adding additional keys to the output if the input is a dictionary.

nodes.label: HubRunnable
nodes.title: LangChain Hub Runnable
nodes.description: Represents a runnable instance stored and pulled from the LangChain Hub, allowing for easy integration of shared runnables.

nodes.label: OpenAIFunctionsRouter
nodes.title: OpenAI Functions Router
nodes.description: A runnable that routes to specific functions based on OpenAI function call outputs, enabling dynamic execution paths.

nodes.label: Config Wrapper
nodes.title: Configuration Wrapper
nodes.description: A utility wrapper for functions that handles StopIteration exceptions by converting them to RuntimeError, preventing issues in asynchronous contexts.

groups.label: Core Interfaces
groups.title: Core Runnable Interfaces
groups.description: Defines the fundamental building blocks and serialization capabilities for all runnables.

groups.label: Composition & Binding
groups.title: Runnable Composition and Binding
groups.description: Components facilitating the composition of runnables and the binding of arguments or configurations.

groups.label: Specialized Runnables
groups.title: Specialized Runnable Implementations
groups.description: Specific runnable implementations for common patterns like message history, hub integration, and function routing.

groups.label: Utilities
groups.title: Helper Utilities
groups.description: Auxiliary components that support the functionality of runnables, such as configuration handling.
